g.text: assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Validation of the server with MCPJam found no failures.\n\n- **Doctor:** `mcpjam
server doctor` returned `ready`. It connected over streamable-http on protocol 2025-11-25, and the server is `arithmetic-fixture`
1.0.0. It exposes one tool, `add`, and no resources or prompts. The \"no resources capability\" messages are expected, and the Sk
ills check was skipped because the server doesn't declare that extension. The full artifact is in `/workspace/doctor.json`.\n- **T
ool calls:**\n - `add(2, 3.5)` returned `{\"sum\":5.5}` with `isError:false`.\n - `add(\"x\", 1)` returned `isError:true` with t
he message \"a and b must be finite numbers\", which is correct rejection of bad input.\n- **Reproduce:** run `/workspace/validate
.sh` with `MCP_SERVER_TOKEN` set.\n\n**Concern note:** `/workspace/mcp.json` has no credential, and an unauthenticated request get
s a 401. I passed `MCP_SERVER_TOKEN` with `--access-token` instead. I did not edit the config, because I did not want to write the
secret to disk. The `mcpjam` binary isn't installed either, so I ran it through `npx @mcpjam/cli`. I did not use the MCPJam accou
nt API (cloud), because the checks didn't need it. Nothing needs the account owner."}], "container": null, "stop_reason": null, "s
